name: aeliqo-v0-1-0-master-foundation
description: Aeliqo 0.1.0 framework source and release workspace

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm build:platform && tsc --project tsconfig.json
scripts.build:platform: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/sdk-web build && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/sdk-react build
scripts.test:next-platform: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/sdk-web build && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/next-platform-fixture build && playwright test --config tests/next-platform/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm build:core && vitest run --config tests/contracts/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:task-experience: pnpm build:core && vitest run --config tests/task-experience/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/task-experience/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:query: pnpm build:core && vitest run --config tests/query/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/query/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:data: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-data/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-data/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:results: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/runtime-results/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/runtime-results/tsconfig.json

scripts.test:agents: pnpm build:agent && vitest run --config tests/agents/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/agents/tsconfig.json --noEmit

scripts.test:visualization:browser: playwright test --config tests/visualization/temporal.playwright.config.mjs && playwright test --config tests/visualization/cartesian.playwright.config.mjs && playwright test --config tests/visualization/playwright.config.mjs

scripts.test:protocol-webmcp: pnpm build:agent && vitest run --config tests/protocol-webmcp/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/protocol-webmcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:protocol-model: pnpm build:agent && vitest run --config tests/protocol-model/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/protocol-model/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:compounds: pnpm build:platform && vitest run --config tests/compound/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/compound/tsconfig.json && node tests/compound/ssr.mjs
scripts.test:compound-semantic: pnpm build:platform && vitest run --config tests/compound-semantic/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/compound-semantic/tsconfig.json

scripts.build:site: pnpm build:platform && pnpm build:agent && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/site build
scripts.test:site: pnpm build:platform && pnpm build:agent && vitest run --config tests/site/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/site/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/site/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:agent-evaluation:host: pnpm build:agent && vitest run --config tests/agent-evaluation/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/agent-evaluation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:scenarios: pnpm build:runtime && vitest run --config tests/scenarios/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/scenarios/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:security: pnpm build:agent && pnpm --filter @aeliqo/testkit build && vitest run --config tests/security/vitest.config.mjs && tsc -p tests/security/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:visual: pnpm build:platform && tsc -p tests/visual/tsconfig.json && playwright test --config tests/visual/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.lint.json && tsc -p apps/site/tsconfig.json --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters && tsc -p apps/studio/tsconfig.json --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters
scripts.test:agent-evaluation:ui: pnpm build:platform && pnpm build:agent && playwright test --config tests/agent-evaluation/ui-development/playwright.config.mjs
